study type: Systematic review and meta-analysis of aggregate and individual patient data from case-control, cohort, population-based studies, and randomized controlled trials.
cohort: The study included a meta-analysis of 5557 intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy cases and 165,136 controls from various studies, and an individual patient data analysis of 5269 intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy cases.
finding: The risk of stillbirth is significantly increased in women with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy and singleton pregnancies when serum bile acid concentrations are 100 mmol/L or more.
country: N/A (Systematic review and meta-analysis, including unpublished data from two UK hospitals but aggregating international studies)
followup_time: N/A (focused on perinatal outcomes during pregnancy and delivery)
